envVars.description: Your own Nansen API key, sent as the `apiKey` header. Sign up at https://nsn.ai/simmer for the Simmer partner discount. A full run costs about 45 credits; Nansen's free tier (100 starter credits + 10/day) covers roughly two runs.

envVars.name: NANSEN_USER_AGENT
envVars.description: Override the browser User-Agent sent to Nansen. Cloudflare rejects the default python-urllib UA, so the skill sends a browser UA already. Only set this if that stops working.

envVars.name: NANSEN_API_BASE
envVars.description: Override the Nansen API base URL. Defaults to https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1.
